title: Karnataka Mango Development and Marketing Corporation will develop platform for domestic marketing of Alphonso mangoes
content: The Karnataka Mango Development and Marketing Corporation will develop a dedicated platform to facilitate the sale of Alphonso mangoes in the domestic market.

title: Let the ink flow: Collectors and craftsmen keep fountain pens alive in Hyderabad
content: At the Hyderabad Fountain Pen Club’s monthly gatherings, collectors, hobbyists and craftsmen come together to share pens, inks and paper, exchange stories and celebrate the art of handwriting. Their passion is complemented by the work of veteran city penmakers who continue to handcraft ebonite fountain pens using time-honoured techniques, keeping alive a tradition that has endured well into the digital age

title: Villagers demand operation of overhead tank for regular water supply in Tiruvannamalai
content: Residents travel at least 5-10 km to fetch a few pots of water from Kilpennathur and Tiruvannamalai towns due to irregular water supply

title: A genetic blueprint for saving Asia’s iconic hornbills
content: A new study by researchers from CCMB-Hyderabad, and the Nature Conservation Foundation- Mysore has decoded the complete genomes of four species, offering fresh insights into their evolution and population history over millions of years. The findings reveal how past climatic shifts shaped hornbill populations and provide valuable genetic resources to guide conservation strategies for these ecologically important seed dispersers

title: Delayed aid, prolonged ordeal
content: For tuberculosis (TB) patients from economically backward regions, financial assistance through government initiatives is as crucial as medication. Delays in disbursing aid are affecting the recovery of patients from across the State as they struggle to afford nutritious food and travel for treatment, writes Nellore Sravani

title: After residents’ protest, civic body retrieves government land from encroachments to set up children's park in Vaniyambadi

title: Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation Commissioner pulls up Larsen & Toubro over delay in issuing water bills
content: Hubballi-Dharwad Municipal Corporation Commissioner Rudresh Ghali on Friday directed Larsen & Toubro, the agency implementing the 24/7 water supply project, to issue water bills to consumers immediately after providing connections, saying the delay was resulting in revenue loss to the civic body

content: Kalaburagi Deputy Commissioner reviews implementation of Prime Minister’s 15-Point Programme for minorities

content: Preliminary reports say the Resistance Front (TRF), an off-shoot of Pakistan based Lashkar-i-Toiba (LeT) is believed to be behind the attack.

title: 4 Mountaineers Killed, 6 Missing After Avalanche Strikes Peak In PoK
content: The avalanche struck the mountain at an altitude of around 7,000 metres Thursday, sweeping away the 10-member climbing team that had begun its summit push, according to the Alpine Club of Pakistan (ACP).

title: Italy Suspends Schengen Agreement With Spain Because Of Ceuta Migrant Crisis
content: On Thursday, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called for Spain to be suspended from the Schengen area, describing the images from Ceuta showing thousands of arriving migrants as "shocking".

title: 57 Dead, 60,000 Enter From Morocco: All About Crisis In Spain's Enclave Ceuta
content: Spain's interior ministry claimed that half of the migrants had already gone back to Morocco, sharing footage of people walking back through a fence door at the border.

title: Uzair Baloch's Brother Shot Multiple Times In Karachi's Lyari By Unknown Gunmen
content: According to a statement issued by Chakiwara police, the 40-year-old was shot on main Chakiwara Road. The two injured bystanders were shifted along with him to Civil Hospital Karachi for treatment.

title: 'Want To Forgive Them': PM Modi On Students Who Abused Him at Jantar Mantar
content: In a video message, PM Modi referred to the events at Jantar Mantar, where a section of protesters allegedly used expletives against him and his late mother.

title: 32 Killed In Pak After Coal Mine Explosion Near Quetta
content: Rescue teams have recovered 32 bodies overnight from two coal mines in the Sorange coalfield near Quetta after a methane gas explosion, while search operations remain underway to find two more miners, according to a report by Dawn citing an official.

title: After Akali Dal, Sacrilege Row Engulfs Bhagwant Mann Government
content: From contributing to the end of Shiromani Akali Dal's dominance after the 2015 incidents to becoming a recurring electoral litmus test for successive governments, the issue of sacrilege has repeatedly reshaped the state's political landscape.

title: Army Officer Killed After SUV Hits Camel In Jaisalmer
content: The accident occurred late Thursday night near Thaiyat Army area, around 18 km from Jaisalmer city, when the three Army officers were returning to the Army station.

title: Gujarat Schools To Stay Shut Tomorrow, Hundreds Evacuated Amid Rain Alert
content: Surat district witnessed some of the state's most significant precautionary measures after receiving between three and 10 inches of rainfall across its talukas.

content: Four other people were also affected and are undergoing treatment at Silchar Medical College and Hospital.

title: Drifting SpaceX Rocket On High-Speed Collision Course With Moon
content: The rocket's upper stage will unintentionally slam into the moon on Wednesday, carving out a crater and sending up a plume of dust and rubble that scientists - and skygazers - are eager to observe.

title: India 'Closely Monitoring' US Bill Proposing 100% Tariffs Over Russian Oil
content: Days after the US Senate cleared a new bill that would authorise President Donald Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100 per cent on India, China and other major buyers of Russian oil and gas, New Delhi on Friday said it was closely monitoring the situation.

title: Feels Like I'm Back To My Country: Taslima Nasreen To NDTV On Kolkata Return
content: Nasreen -- - who made her home in Kolkata after leaving Dhaka -- had to leave the City of Joy in 2007 following massive protests over her controversial book 'Dwikhandito'. She had been living in Delhi since.

title: Gujarat Chief Minister Reviews Rain Preparedness, Puts 10 Districts On High Alert
content: Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel paid a surprise late-night visit to the State Emergency Operations Centre (SEOC) on Friday to review the prevailing rain situation across Gujarat and assess the state's preparedness for any weather-related emergencies.

title: Delhi Bans Drones, Paragliders, Hot Air Balloons Ahead Of Independence Day
content: The order prohibits flying of para-gliders, para-motors, hang-gliders, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), unmanned aircraft systems (UASs), microlight aircraft, remotely piloted aircraft, hot air balloonsover the jurisdiction of the NCT of Delhi during the notified period.

title: 250 Km In 2 Hours: Donor Heart Races Via Vande Bharat To Save Life
content: In a historic medical first for Indian Railways, a live donor heart was rushed 250 km from Surat to Ahmedabad on Friday via a high-speed "green corridor" created aboard the Vande Bharat Express and across city streets to save the life of a critically ill cardiac patient.

title: S Jaishankar Speaks To Iran's Araghchi, Condemns Attacks On Ships, Sailors
content: In a post on X, Jaishankar said that India condemns attacks on commercial shipping and seafarers by any party. He also stated that India always supports dialogue and diplomacy and that he was informed about Iran's perspective about current developments.

title: 'Pak-trained Mujahideen turned guns inwards': MEA slams Islamabad over PoK crackdown
content: India condemned Pakistan's admission of training and arming militants who have turned against the state. The Ministry of External Affairs also criticized Pakistan's harsh crackdown on protesters in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. Over forty civilians were reportedly killed during the violent suppression of peaceful demonstrations. India stated that Pakistan's actions exposed its disdain for the region's innocent inhabitants.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: SC slaps Rs 1 lakh fine on Rajasthan government for harassing official
content: The Supreme Court has ordered Rajasthan to pay one lakh rupees to a government official. This payment is compensation for harassment caused by political interference in a prosecution sanction. The court criticized the joint secretary of the former chief minister for undue influence. Such interference was deemed a blatant display of political dictate by the state. The official was unnecessarily dragged to court, prompting the court's strong observations.

title: CWG: India strike double gold in judo as Asmita Dey, Harsh Singh make history
content: Asmita created history by becoming the first Indian judoka to win a Commonwealth Games gold medal after defeating Canada's Heidi Quach in the women's 48kg final.

title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over 'hidden' tip buttons
content: New York City's delivery workers have gained over one hundred million dollars. This increase follows new rules requiring clear tipping options at checkout. Apps like Uber Eats and DoorDash redesigned their interfaces after city enforcement actions. Workers now see significantly higher hourly earnings and more deliveries completed. The administration continues its efforts to improve app-based worker conditions.

title: 27-year study finds female birds often die younger than males
content: A comprehensive study spanning twenty-seven years has revealed that female birds face lower survival rates compared to their male counterparts. This trend has been observed in thirty-five distinct bird species throughout North America. The challenges posed by migration and reproduction seem to disproportionately affect females. Furthermore, genetic factors related to sex chromosomes may play a role in this issue.

title: Arctic charr evolved distinct metabolism after 100 years in Lake Allos
content: Introduced to Lake Allos in 1924, Arctic charr exhibit remarkable metabolic adaptations within just a century. These fish showcase rapid physiological changes, attributed mainly to their phenotypic plasticity, resulting in distinct body shapes. Notably, juveniles from Lake Allos consistently demonstrate elevated metabolic rates, even under controlled conditions. This research underscores the species' ability to swiftly adapt to their ever-changing environmental landscape.

title: US plans $100K fee on foreign students: What it means for engineers
content: The US government is reportedly considering a $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking post-graduation work. This proposed fee targets the Optional Practical Training program, impacting many international graduates.  This follows a significant H-1B visa fee hike imposed on sponsoring companies last year.  Indian engineers, who dominate H-1B approvals, face increased challenges in securing US careers.  The new measures may significantly narrow career paths for many skilled foreign professionals.

title: Hockey jersey row: Dilip Tirkey questions process, his federation cites precedent
content: Hockey India president Dilip Tirkey questioned the jersey colour change process.  He stated the decision lacked executive board discussion and his prior knowledge.  Executive director RK Srivastava defended the saffron kit based on technical and performance factors.  Other board members also raised concerns about transparency and accountability.  This controversy emerges amid ongoing governance scrutiny for Hockey India.

title: 'I felt that everything was over': Asmita remembers late father after historic judo gold
content: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a gripping golden score final match. This historic victory came after overcoming personal tragedy and immense dedication. Harsh Singh also won a gold medal in the men's 60kg judo event. These twin triumphs marked a significant breakthrough for Indian judo.

title: How Travis Kelce turned criticism into one of the NFL's greatest careers ever
content: For Travis Kelce, constructive criticism serves as a catalyst for growth and improvement.  His passion for football, established long before his fame, has fueled his journey. Despite setbacks, such as not making the 2025 NFL playoffs, Kelce stresses the importance of embracing feedback and maintaining daily dedication to progress, especially for younger generations.

title: Connor McDavid faces backlash over comments on Maple Leafs' Gavin McKenna
content: Connor McDavid faced criticism from Sid Seixeiro regarding his remarks on Gavin McKenna. Seixeiro argued McDavid does not understand Toronto's intense media scrutiny. He believes Edmonton's media environment differs significantly from Toronto's pressures. McKenna, the top draft pick, faces high expectations from fans and media. The prospect signed a contract and will play alongside Auston Matthews.

title: How family sacrifice fueled Usain Bolt's rise to sprinting greatness worldwide
content: Usain Bolt’s incredible career was built on more than speed. His parents, Wellesley and Jennifer Bolt, helped him stay disciplined, focused and humble from childhood to Olympic glory. Even after becoming the fastest man in history, Bolt remained deeply connected to his family. His story continues to inspire because it shows that lasting success begins with love, sacrifice and strong values.

title: MAGA piles on to Morocco as Trump twits Spain over Ceuta
content: The migrant surge into Ceuta is escalating into a geopolitical flashpoint. President Trump is using the crisis to reinforce his border security message. This event is also fueling online conspiracy theories linking it to wider international disputes. US officials have intervened in Spain's domestic politics regarding immigration policies. The situation highlights strained US-Spain relations and territorial claims over Ceuta.

title: Heaps of cash & gold, 242 vehicles & more: WB CM Suvendu lists Tulu Mondal's assets
content: Authorities have confiscated more than Rs 150 crore in cash, gold, and various assets belonging to mining mogul Tulu Mondal. This haul comprises numerous vehicles, petrol pumps, and several properties. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari attributed the rise of this illegal operation to the former Chief Minister, claiming that illegal stone mining led to a staggering Rs 15,000 crore revenue loss over a stretch of fifteen years.

title: Tough road for Trump: Why sanctions Bill for tariffs on Russian oil buyers may fail
content: Lawmakers from both parties, along with industry trade groups, have raised concerns over a section of the legislation that would allow Trump to impose hefty tariffs on countries that buy significant volumes of Russian oil and gas.

title: Rashmika Mandanna suffers major hip injury on set; doctors advise six weeks of rest
content: Actress Rashmika Mandanna sustained a major hip injury while filming an intense dance sequence. Doctors have advised her a complete rest period of six weeks for recovery. This injury will likely impact her ongoing film schedules and endorsement commitments. Mandanna is currently working on several big-budget films and numerous brand endorsements. Fans are sending well wishes for her swift return to full fitness.

title: Mukesh Khanna says CJP doesn't represent students or Gen Z
content: Veteran actor Mukesh Khanna has weighed in on the ongoing controversy surrounding the recent Gen Z protests, reacting to the self-styled Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and backing criticism over the alleged use of abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The actor described some protesters as "cockroaches" and alleged that they did not represent genuine students. His comments come days after actress-politician Kangana Ranaut sparked a row by referring to some protesters as "gutter chhaap" and condemning the language used during the demonstrations and on social media.

title: Perfect 5-0! Indian boxers storm into CWG finals after dominant semifinal sweep
content: India's boxing contingent achieved a flawless 5-0 record in the semifinals. Five Indian boxers have now secured spots in the gold medal bouts. Arundhati Choudhary defeated the defending champion in a significant upset victory. Jaismine Lamboria and Preeti Pawar also advanced with dominant performances. Ankush Panghal and Jadumani Singh completed the perfect sweep for India.

title: ‘Samudra Manthan’: Cabinet approves Rs 84,084 cr scheme for oil & gas exploration
content: The scheme will be implemented through FY2030-31 with an aim to harness India's vast offshore energy resources - in what the government has termed as a modern day Samudra Manthan.

title: 'Clarify algorithmic bias': Govt summons Meta's global team over PM Modi post
content: India's government has summoned Meta's global team to discuss Prime Minister Modi's post. Officials will question the social media giant on algorithmic bias and content moderation. Meta's global representatives will also appear before a parliamentary panel for scrutiny. Hyderabad police have also registered cases against Meta India's head. This marks an escalation in the government's oversight of the company's practices.

title: Russia hits Ukraine military cargo vessel near Odesa as Kyiv targets oil refinery
content: Russia claimed striking a vessel near Odesa carrying military cargo. Ukraine reported hitting Russia's Volgograd oil refinery and port infrastructure. Both nations are increasingly targeting logistics and supply chains. This escalation highlights the Black Sea's crucial role in the ongoing conflict. Ukraine also continues its campaign against Russian logistics targets.

title: India likely to play waiting game with Bumrah for Sri Lanka Tests | Exclusive
content: The 32-year-old was picked in the Shubman Gill-led squad for the series, but subject to fitness clearance. Bumrah missed the third ODI against England at Lord's due to an "impact injury" to his left knee but looked very sharp in the two fixtures he did play.

title: Vedika Pinto's sea-facing Mumbai home with Goan-Portuguese charm
content: 'Musafir Cafe' actor Vedika Pinto gives an intimate tour of her 4000 sq ft Mumbai home, blending contemporary design with Goan-Portuguese touches that pay homage to her father's ancestry. From a restored newspaper artwork bought in Beirut to a painting with a cheeky "Green Choli" backstory, Vedika opens up about the stories behind her home's most striking corners.

title: 'Done by BJP goons': CJP's Dipke responds after injured Delhi cops' kin seek justice
content: Families of the injured Delhi Police officers are advocating for a discussion in Parliament regarding their pain. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke suggested a deliberate effort to target students amid the protests, expressing concern for the hurt officers while also questioning how students were being treated. The families presented proof of injuries and extensive damage, asserting that anti-social groups had incited the violence.

title: Why 2030 WC hosts Spain, Portugal could miss tournament amid FIFA-UEFA standoff
content: UEFA’s threat to boycott FIFA competitions has raised the possibility of an unprecedented 2030 World Cup scenario, with co-hosts Spain and Portugal potentially missing their own tournament. The standoff centres on FIFA’s plan to sell a minority stake in commercial rights, which has triggered widespread opposition, internal criticism and fears the centenary World Cup could be reshaped by a historic football power struggle.

title: Rajinikanth skipped Malaysia launch for 'Jailer 2' to avoid Vijay comparisons
content: Jailer 2's audio launch venue is reportedly not Malaysia as Rajinikanth wishes to avoid comparisons. He reportedly stated he does not want to compete with Vijay's previous event. This reported decision has sparked discussions among fans and cinema enthusiasts. Makers have not yet officially announced the date or location for the audio launch. Jailer 2 is scheduled for a theatrical release on October 15.

title: India assure three judo medals as Asmita, Harsh and Yamini reach CWG finals
content: Asmita produced a strong comeback to beat Scotland's Summer Shaw by yuko in the women's 48kg semifinal and book her place in the final, where she will face Canada's Heidi Quach later on Friday.

title: 'System has collapsed': Pak minister warns of power of 'cockroaches'
content: Pakistan's interior minister declared the nation's governance system has collapsed. He urged political parties to create new administrative units and provinces. Sweeping constitutional and governance reforms are essential for Pakistan's progress. Without structural changes, the country will face recurring political and economic crises. Youth demand merit-based jobs and equal opportunities, not financial assistance.

title: PM Modi, Burnham discuss trade pact in 1st call
content:
NEW DELHI: Congratulating UK PM Andy Burnham on assuming office, PM Narendra Modi said the two leaders will collaborate closely to fully harness the trade and investment opportunities presented by the recently operationalised India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), for the "shared prosperity and well-being of both our people". Burnham officially took office as UK PM on July 20, 2026. The leaders discussed the West Asia conflict, agreeing to continue to work closely together towards de-escalation and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. According to the UK, Burnham set out his ambitions to further enhance ties, including through the UK-India Vision 2035 framework.
